reason: Room: the rewrite grows sky_check by 53 bytes (49 -> 102, recounted), all in bank 4 before REN_BASE (&B400, ASSERTed in src/main.6502: 'bank 4 overruns the renderer's workspace'). The shipping build has 131 bytes there (SKIP PAD_END at &B37D), but the gameplay build (GAMEPLAY_SHIELD, which also puts shield_hi and sky_edges at bank 4's end) ends at &B3F6 (build/strykers-gameplay.lst line 11718): 10 bytes free, so +53 overruns REN_BASE by 43 and the gameplay build (-Gameplay / make gameplay, the published WIP disc) no longer assembles. The proposer measured only the bench build. Otherwise the logic checks out from the project lens: sky_q (&E0) is not read after sky_check (sky_draw/sky_zero store it first); sky_row never writes X; whole rows have rt = 7 so Y = ry|7 = 8k+7 with ry <= 104 (Y <= 111, so the unrolled BPL matches the original's); C after sky_row's ASLs is clear so the offset 5*(skip-1) and C=1 hold; bank 4 is sideways RAM so the self-modified BRA operand is writable and the routine is not run from an interrupt. Refuted on room alone.
